verdict.rationale: LibreChat's source is hosted publicly on GitHub (danny-avila/LibreChat), and independent community users repeatedly call it an open source frontend/backend, so the source is readable under an open model. Worries about acquisition and future monetization are speculation, not contradicting evidence, so they don't create a dispute. Missing for 10: no first-party statement naming the specific license or its terms, no evidence of a LICENSE file or contribution/redistribution rights.
